$comment: Per-site harness rules. Every site-specific measuring rule lives here; the scripts carry none. Delete the keys you don't need (defaults in scripts/lib/config.js). Keys starting with $ are notes.
name: viasat
$access: mode: live | allowlisted | headed | chrome | snapshot. allowlisted: header = the header name the site owner allowlisted, its VALUE comes from the env var named in headerEnv (never stored here); origin = staging/origin URL outside the WAF that replaces source.origin. headed: profileDir keeps the session the user created. chrome: the user starts Chrome with --remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir=<dir>; cdpEnv names the env var holding a non-default CDP URL.
$blockRequests: regexes for requests aborted in the measuring browser only: personalization decisions, chat loaders, A/B tools, so the default experience is always measured
$sectionRoot: container whose children are the page's sections, used by @sec:N and @has:TEXT. A selector, { "parentOf": selector }, or per side { "source": ..., "rebuild": ... }. Default: main (or body) descended while it has one child.
$hide: selectors set to display:none on both sides (third-party widgets, sticky clones that sit over the section being measured). invisible = visibility:hidden (keeps the footprint). hideByText hides buttons by exact label.
$video: providers: "all" or a list of vidyard, youtube, vimeo, brightcove, wistia. Their iframes are removed as they appear so both sides show the poster frame.
$carousels: frozen on slide 1 before capture: slick (jQuery), swiper, hook (window.freezeCarousels on the rebuild side, see starter/)
$variantGuard: experiments that swap content: reload until the control experience is served. applies = only check pages that have this selector; require/forbid = [{ sel (resolver), text? }]
$prepare: steps run after freezing: { wait }, { mouse: [x, y] } (negative x = from the right edge), { key }, { domClick: resolverSelector }, { click: "selector#visibleIndex" }, { scrollTo }, { js }
$beforeSection: steps right before capturing sections whose name matches the regex key; a steps array (both sides) or { source, rebuild }
$report: visibleImage: print the alt of the large image in the first viewport (shows a failed carousel freeze)
$gate: pass = pixel >= gate.pixel and 0 computed-style mismatches; tolerance = numeric px difference tolerated; threshold = pixelmatch colour threshold
